entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker with an etherium arm and the Planar Bridge in his chest, serving the Phyrexians for the promise of a darksteel body, who secretly turns against Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem planeswalker, held captive and dismantled by Phyrexian priests, who still keeps his mind.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker, now a compleated follower of Elesh Norn who quotes her scripture and wears Elspeth's old cloak.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor who has barred access to New Phyrexia's core and welcomes Karn as Father; she promises Tezzeret a reward but means to use him.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A Phyrexian left in charge of operations on Shiv by Sheoldred, who is forced to report to Tezzeret.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who interfered with Karn's planeswalking and was helped back to her lair by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: An ill-tempered praetor with whom Tezzeret has a loose partnership and who hides his domain from the Darksteel Eye.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A praetor who developed compleation, first using it on Tamiyo.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: The first planeswalker compleated.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker, killed, whom Tezzeret once served and hated.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker whose former cloak Ajani now wears.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whose group on Ravnica receives Tezzeret's information and who left Tezzeret a hollow shell.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian whose endoskeleton carried the essence of Kaldheim's World Tree through Tezzeret's portal.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Karn's best friend, who named him.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A previous lord of Mirrodin whom Jin-Gitaxias called a valuable mistake.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: The speaker of the epigraph.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-controlled plane, formerly Mirrodin, where Tezzeret descends into its core.

entities.name: Fair Basilica
entities.description: Elesh Norn's basilica of ossified Phyrexian corpses where Karn is dissected.

entities.name: Mycosynth Garden
entities.description: The metallic lattice that grows over the plane's core and merges metal and flesh.

entities.name: Panopticon
entities.description: A darksteel tower in the Mycosynth Garden housing the Darksteel Eye.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Dominaria's red region where Phyrexian troops hide in the Cometia Crater cave complex.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: A settlement to which the Planeswalkers were tracked back.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Tezzeret is told to lead the effort against the interlopers.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Plane of the Seekers of Carmot.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: The artifact in Tezzeret's chest that is eating him alive.

entities.name: Darksteel Eye
entities.description: A diamond-shaped monolith in the Panopticon that views any part of New Phyrexia but cannot see Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A device made by the Phyrexians with the essence of Kaldheim's World Tree.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: Elesh Norn's religious order of Phyrexians.

entities.name: Suture Bishops
entities.description: Phyrexian priests who dissect Karn.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: A fraudulent order on Esper that Tezzeret belonged to.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The few remaining partially metallic natives.

events.summary: Karn lies bound on a slab as Suture Bishops dissect him, offering no resistance, while Tezzeret watches.
events.quote: But Karn gave no resistance to the team of aspirants as they bound him into place

events.summary: Ajani, compleated, quotes Elesh Norn's scripture over Karn as the priests dismantle him.
events.quote: Only in her grace are we saved,

events.summary: An angel blocks Tezzeret from leaving and orders him to carry the pieces of Karn to Elesh Norn for his reward.
events.quote: you will bring the pieces of Father to our Mother.

events.summary: Ajani gives Tezzeret his cloak, once worn by Elspeth, and Tezzeret suspects the true Ajani remains suppressed within.
events.quote: it was the same cloak once worn by Elspeth Tirel.

events.summary: Tezzeret feigns obedience and sets out through the Fair Basilica toward the core pushing Karn's pieces.
Tezzeret suspects a trap, kills the Phyrexian guide with a thrust and heads into the Mycosynth alone.
events.quote: with a single well-placed thrust, ran it through.

events.summary: Tezzeret reaches Memnarch's restored darksteel Panopticon and cannot open its door.
events.quote: darksteel, as a matter of fact

events.summary: Karn speaks, explaining he is tethered to the plane and offering to open the tower, since it was once his realm.
events.quote: I can take you inside. This was my realm once, after all.

events.summary: Tezzeret detaches Karn's head and Karn uses it to open the darksteel door.
events.quote: Karn's efforts caused the door to slide open.

events.summary: In the Darksteel Eye, Tezzeret sees vast Phyrexian legions assembling but cannot view Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.
events.quote: he discovered that two locations managed to defy the eye's intrusion.

events.summary: Tezzeret and Karn argue over Karn's responsibility for New Phyrexia and Bolas's threat, and Tezzeret reveals he suggested eliminating the plane to Bolas.
events.quote: His first act as god-emperor would have been to obliterate New Phyrexia from existence.

events.summary: Karn admits he hears the same oil voices as Tezzeret, and Tezzeret threatens him but relents, fearing compleation.
events.quote: The same voices I heard when the oil had command of my heart.

events.summary: Tezzeret reaches Elesh Norn at the heart of the plane, where she takes Karn's torso and welcomes him to the great work.
events.quote: We welcome you to our great work.

events.summary: Elesh Norn tells Tezzeret he will be herald on Dominaria; he realizes she will not give him his body and resolves to wage war on her.
events.quote: Elesh Norn had no intention of fulfilling her promise.

events.summary: Karn speaks of Jhoira and is cut off by Elesh Norn; Tezzeret sees it as a good move on his part.
events.quote: Jhoira . . . Jhoira is my friend . . . my best friend.

events.summary: Elesh Norn dismisses Tezzeret, who leaves angrily.
events.quote: With a growl, Tezzeret turned and walked away.

events.summary: Tezzeret enters Shiv's cave complex and brutally forces Rona to give a status report.
events.quote: I've been told that unprotected flesh takes a few seconds to vaporize in the Blind Eternities.

events.summary: Rona reports the Phyrexians' losses and that the Planeswalkers have been tracked to New Argive.
events.quote: But we have been able to track them back to New Argive.

relations.note: Elesh Norn is the Mother of the Machine Orthodoxy.
relations.quote: Hated anything to do with the Machine Orthodoxy.

relations.note: Tezzeret serves her for a promised reward while planning betrayal.
relations.quote: Then you will receive what has been promised to you.
Ever since aligning himself with Urabrask
Our old forms are cages that the Mother melts down and reforges into destiny.

relations.note: Karn created Mirrodin and its passageways.
relations.quote: Some of these passageways had been extant ever since Karn created them
Things have been difficult between us,

relations.note: Karn calls Jhoira his best friend.
relations.quote: Jhoira . . . Jhoira is my friend . . . my best friend.

relations.note: Sheoldred left Rona in charge on Shiv.
